title.rendered: LIC Job 2027 | Management Trainee – Marketing & Sales – for Fresher, 6 Lakh CTC Apply by 28 Nov

content.rendered:
LIC Job 2027 is hiring freshers for Management Trainee – Marketing & Sales with up to ₹6 Lakh CTC. Check eligibility and apply by Nov 28!

New Delhi: LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL) has officially opened applications for the Management Trainee – Marketing & Sales position for freshers across multiple Indian cities. Listed via the official Internshala recruitment portal, this one-year management training opportunity offers an annual training compensation of up to ₹6 Lakh CTC (₹40,000 to ₹50,000 per month).

For MBA graduates and freshers looking to start their career in the financial services and housing finance sector, this LIC Job 2027 provides structured corporate training and potential long-term absorption. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their online applications before the November 28, 2026 deadline.

About LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL)

LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL) is one of India’s largest and most trusted housing finance companies, promoted by the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). With an extensive nationwide network of regional, back, and area offices, LIC HFL provides long-term finance to individuals for purchasing or constructing residential properties.

Joining LIC HFL as a Management Trainee gives freshers direct exposure to retail credit operations, builder partnerships, and customer acquisition in a high-trust financial institution.

LIC Job 2027: Key Highlights

Vacancy & Role Responsibilities

LIC HFL has advertised 50 vacancies for the Management Trainee – Marketing & Sales track across major metro and tier-2 cities in India. Selected candidates undergo a structured one-year training period handling key business-facing functions:

  • Sales & Business Development: Source new customers for housing loans, Loan Against Property (LAP), and retail finance products through online and field activities.
  • Builder & Channel Relationships: Identify upcoming housing projects, build partnerships with builders and developers, and support Direct Selling Agents (DSAs).
  • Customer Guidance: Advise homebuyers on loan eligibility, product structures, and required documentation.
  • Credit & Loan Coordination: Assist internal teams with preliminary loan appraisal, compliance checks, and document processing.
  • Market Intelligence: Track local real estate trends and report customer feedback to support regional business growth.

Eligibility Criteria and Important Conditions

Before submitting your application, verify that you satisfy every mandatory requirement stated in the official job notice:

Educational Qualification & Experience

  • Mandatory Degree: Candidates must hold a completed MBA degree from a recognized university or institute. Candidates with only a general undergraduate degree are not eligible.
  • Fresher Eligibility: Freshers are fully eligible to apply. Having 0 to 1 year of prior experience in sales, field marketing, or negotiation is an added advantage.

Mandatory Location, Language & Bond Conditions

  • Local City Residence: Applicants must reside in one of the specified hiring cities (including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Bhopal, Indore, Patna, and others).
  • Local Language Fluency: Candidates must be fluent in the local language of the city they apply for.
  • Service Bond: Selected trainees are required to sign a minimum 2-year service commitment from the date of joining.

Salary, Stipend & Career Growth Benefits

  • Training Stipend (Year 1): Selected Management Trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹40,000 to ₹50,000, which equals an annual training compensation of ₹4.8 Lakh to ₹6 Lakh CTC.
  • Post-Training Absorption: Upon successfully completing the one-year training and meeting LIC HFL’s prescribed performance criteria, candidates may be absorbed into a full-time role with a CTC of ₹14 Lakh per annum or more.
  • Work Schedule: Includes second and fourth Saturdays off as per company policy.

How to Apply for LIC Job 2027 (Step-by-Step)

Follow these steps to submit your application online before November 28, 2026:

  1. Open the Official Job Portal: Visit the verified LIC Housing Finance Limited Management Trainee Listing on Internshala.
  2. Sign In or Register: Log in to your Internshala candidate account (or create a free account using your email address).
  3. Verify City & MBA Details: Ensure your current city of residence and MBA degree details are accurately updated in your profile.
  4. Answer Screening Questions: Click Apply Now, answer the employer’s assessment questions clearly, and submit your updated resume before the November 28 deadline.

1. Who can apply for the LIC HFL Management Trainee – Marketing & Sales Job 2027?

Freshers and candidates with 0 to 1 year of sales experience who hold a completed MBA degree and reside in one of the eligible hiring cities can apply.

2. What is the salary or CTC for the LIC Management Trainee role?

Selected candidates receive a monthly stipend of ₹40,000 to ₹50,000 during the 1-year training period (₹4.8 Lakh to ₹6 Lakh annual CTC), with potential absorption at ₹14 LPA or more based on performance criteria.

3. What is the last date to apply for LIC Job 2027?

Eligible candidates must submit their online applications through the official Internshala listing on or before November 28, 2026.

4. Is an MBA degree mandatory for this LIC Housing Finance Limited job?

Yes, an MBA degree is mandatory. Candidates holding only a general graduation degree are not eligible under the recruitment rules.

5. Is there any service bond for selected Management Trainees?

Yes, selected candidates are required to sign a minimum 2-year service commitment from the date of joining.

6. Does LIC HFL charge any application fee for this recruitment?

No. There is no application fee mentioned on the official listing. Do not pay any money to third parties claiming to offer guaranteed placement.
